summary: Accept as test-only hardening. The candidate adds a focused regression but no production source change, and the same regression passes on the recorded base where the canonical NPU MoE parameter-layout correction is already present. Independent AMD GPU loader checks cover repeated separate gate/up/down reloads including the reported 1408-row dimension. Real Ascend kernel behavior and end-to-end scheduler survival remain unverified.

tests.what_was_measured: At the exact candidate commit, three focused tests exercised mocked NPU post-processing followed by the real FusedMoE separate gate/up/down tensor loaders; all passed.
The candidate regression, preserved outside the checkout, also passed unchanged on recorded base 358c163, proving the candidate is test-only hardening rather than a new behavioral fix.

remaining_counterexamples: No Ascend device, CANN, or torch_npu runtime was available, so actual npu_format_cast and Ascend grouped-matmul behavior were not independently executed.
No full DeepSeekV3.2 Engine or HTTP update_weights_from_disk run established scheduler survival after reload.
The candidate test mocks npu_format_cast and directly invokes loader methods; it does not exercise model weight-name mapping, scheduler subprocess handling, HTTP transport, or distributed execution.
The candidate changes only tests and reports; the production correction predates it on the recorded base.
